Upper Endoscopy and Colonoscopy Report
Date of service: 2026-10-29
Endoscopist: Synthetic Endoscopist, MD (fictional)
Sedation: propofol by a CRNA (fictional)
UPPER ENDOSCOPY
The gastroscope was advanced to the second part of the duodenum. Cold forceps biopsies were taken from the gastric
antrum.
COLONOSCOPY
The colonoscope was advanced to the cecum and the ileocecal valve was photographed.
Withdrawal time
9 minutes
Bowel preparation
Adequate, Boston score 8
A 6 mm polyp was removed with a cold snare, and one prophylactic clip was placed.
Impression: antral biopsies; one polyp removed.
